name: Handing in The Videre Elixir takes one elixir and leaves the rest (#11731)
contract: The Videre Elixir 3909 asks for 1 Videre Elixir 11243, while the repeatable Videre Elixir 4041 hands out 3 and Meet at the Grave 3912 tells the player to drink one. 11243 is bound as a quest item (Bonding 4) but has an on-use spell, so it does something on its own like Clara's Fresh Apple 8683 in the COA-10637 contract. RewardQuest discarded the whole lot of a Bonding 4 item before it looked at that, so the hand-in destroyed all 3. It takes the 1 asked and leaves 2. Essence of the Elements 11129 has Bonding 4 and no spell, so its surplus is still discarded at the hand-in of The Last Element 7201 (COA-10637).

steps.label: SETUP: a holds the 1 asked and the 2 further Videre Elixirs
DISCRIMINATING: the hand-in takes the 1 asked and leaves 2 Videre Elixirs
SETUP: a holds the 10 asked and 3 extra Essences of the Elements
CONTROL: an item without a spell is still discarded in full
